teams.detail: Jedd Fisch's staff landed a 4-star cornerback, the class's highest-rated commitment, while 4-star WR commit Tre Moore keeps drawing buzz at summer 7v7 events; Fisch remains the play-caller after OC Jimmie Dougherty's February departure. Season opens Sunday, Sept. 6 vs. Washington State (1 p.m. PT, NBC) at Husky Stadium.

Danny Sprinkle remains on hot-seat watch after last season's 16-17 (7-13 Big Ten) finish as programs nationally navigate the NCAA's chaotic '5-in-5' eligibility fight reshaping rosters this summer. Center Hannes Steinbach, picked 14th overall by Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft, remains the program's headline offseason story.

Full-squad training camp opens Friday with nine public practices running through Aug. 13. Seattle's entire 2026 draft class is under contract after signing first-rounder Jadarian Price; the team also added CB Brandon Johnson, waived TE Harrison Bryant, and placed RB Zach Charbonnet on the PUP list. Safety Nick Emmanwori, recovering from ankle surgery, is expected back by Week 1.

CBS Sports handed Detroit a 'C' grade for an offseason that added Isaiah Joe, John Collins, Gary Harris, and Taurean Prince plus draft picks Ebuka Okorie and Ugonna Onyenso. Restricted free agent center Jalen Duren remains unsigned three-plus weeks into the market, with the Pistons' reported offer still below what he's eligible for. Detroit finished 60-22 last season (East's No. 1 seed) before falling to Cleveland in the conference semis.

Cincinnati beat Seattle 5-3 Wednesday as Sal Stewart's go-ahead three-run homer in the seventh sealed it, dropping the Mariners to 51-52. Seattle is off Thursday before opening a four-game series at the Texas Rangers on Friday, July 24.

headlines.headline: LeBron James tells Lakers he's leaving for an unprecedented 24th season elsewhere
headlines.detail: LeBron James has informed the Lakers he won't return for 2026-27, with agent Rich Paul saying there's no rush on a decision as the Cavaliers, Heat, 76ers, and Warriors circle. Lakers governor Jeanie Buss thanked James for eight seasons in LA, including the 2020 championship, as the Association's biggest offseason storyline remains unresolved.

headlines.headline: Panthers lose second-year pass rusher Nic Scourton to a season-ending ACL tear on day one of camp
headlines.detail: Carolina outside linebacker Nic Scourton, who posted 47 tackles and five sacks as a 2025 rookie starter, tore his ACL on a wet field during Thursday's first training camp practice - a major blow opposite newly signed edge rusher Jaelan Phillips as all 32 NFL teams open camp by July 28.

headlines.headline: Clemson accuses Ole Miss's Pete Golding of tampering as NCAA opens investigation at SEC Media Days
headlines.detail: Clemson coach Dabo Swinney used Day 3 of SEC Media Days to detail tampering allegations against Ole Miss's Pete Golding, accusing him of offering linebacker Luke Ferrelli - the ACC's reigning Defensive Rookie of the Year - a $1 million contract while Ferrelli was still on Clemson's roster. The NCAA has opened an investigation while Golding used his own media-day session to call out what he called hypocrisy around portal tampering leaguewide.

headlines.headline: NCAA's '5-in-5' eligibility chaos deepens as Ohio injunction returns 15 players for a fifth season
headlines.detail: A July 9 Ohio state court injunction is forcing the NCAA to grandfather in 15 men's college basketball players who had exhausted eligibility under the old rules, reopening rosters that programs like Gonzaga, Texas Tech, and LSU had already finalized around now-departed seniors. The NCAA and its top conferences remain opposed to the ruling and are fighting it as more state and federal lawsuits are expected.
